The file lists the vortex centres (nm) seen in a model image of the Abrikosov vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor in a perpendicular magnetic field. Model conditions: the only measured input is the applied magnetic field (188.7 G = 18.87 mT) reported by Cottet et al. (arXiv:1401.4062; MgB2, cryo-Lorentz TEM at 5 K); the vortices form an ideal triangular lattice with exactly one superconducting flux quantum per vortex, no pinning disorder, lattice defects or thermal motion, and a uniform field, which is the idealization the paper compares its images with; the map is a finite patch of about 97 vortices in an arbitrary orientation. The magnetic induction inside the superconductor is B = 18.87 mT. How much magnetic flux does each vortex carry, in units of 10⁻¹⁵ Wb?

选项：
A. 1.034 ×10⁻¹⁵ Wb
B. 2.068 ×10⁻¹⁵ Wb
C. 2.388 ×10⁻¹⁵ Wb
D. 4.136 ×10⁻¹⁵ Wb

附件：vortex-MgB2-1887G.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文实测磁场（或实测晶格常数）构建的理想三角涡旋晶格模型（约 97 个涡旋，确定性旋转）；不是实测涡旋位置。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
